profile.summary: A nonprofit that runs a paid, seven-week summer fellowship for professionals. Fellows spend half their time on policy projects with an elected official and half with a community partner organization, in about ten U.S. cities.

sources.title: Urban Leaders Fellowship - Nonprofit Explorer - ProPublica
